# ztna_connector_scheduled_upgrade (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Schedule an upgrade for a specific ZTNA Connector.
# Use the ztna_connector_images data source to retrieve a valid image_id.
resource "ztna_connector_scheduled_upgrade" "example" {
  oid                = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
  image_id           = "7.0.0-123"
  scheduled_download = "2025-01-15T02:00:00Z"
  scheduled_upgrade  = "2025-01-15T03:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image_id` (String) The connector image version ID to upgrade to.
- `oid` (String) Parent connector OID. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `scheduled_download` (String) The scheduled download time in RFC3339 format (UTC).  If omitted, defaults to current UTC time.
- `scheduled_upgrade` (String) The scheduled upgrade time in RFC3339 format (UTC).  Must be after the scheduled_download time. If omitted, defaults to current UTC time.

### Read-Only

- `tfid` (String)


## Import

The following command can be used to import a resource not managed by Terraform:

```bash
terraform import ztna_connector_scheduled_upgrade.example :::oid
```
